email.subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – coupon, invoice and expiry date
email.body_text:
Hi Sanjay,

Thank you for your time on our call. You wanted help with a coupon that was not applying at checkout, a wrong company name on your invoice, and extending the coupon's expiry date. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- Following our guidance, you assigned your coupon to the Advanced Course, and you confirmed the discount now shows at checkout.

What we'll do next:
- Our team will extend the coupon's expiry date tomorrow.
- We will check the wrong company name in the GST part of your invoice and let you know by tomorrow.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-05

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
